text: Bellingcat's 2019 profile ties Len Blavatnik's fortune to Russian oil and to US-sanctioned partners Vekselberg and Deripaska. The National Gallery named Room 34 for his Blavatnik Family Foundation on 7 May 2025, in recognition of the foundation's gift to its bicentenary.

text: Bellingcat's 2019 profile ties Len Blavatnik's fortune to Russian oil and to US-sanctioned partners Vekselberg and Deripaska. The National Portrait Gallery took £10 million from his foundation in 2022 and named its first floor the Blavatnik Wing.

text: Bellingcat reports Len Blavatnik gave about $60 million toward Tate Modern's Blavatnik Building, after making billions in Russian oil with Viktor Vekselberg. The US sanctioned Vekselberg and Oleg Deripaska in 2018. Blavatnik is not on a sanctions list.

text: Bellingcat's 2019 profile ties Len Blavatnik's fortune to Russian oil and to US-sanctioned partners Vekselberg and Deripaska. The V&A named its entrance hall for him in 2016, and its David Bowie Centre credits a 2023 Blavatnik Family Foundation donation.

text: Bellingcat reports a bomb dropped on Sanaa airport carries a lot number showing General Dynamics Tactical Systems made it in 2017. Art Institute trustee Steven Crown's family built its wealth on General Dynamics; 2023 protesters demanded the Henry Crown Gallery be renamed.
